hec.rss.model

Class OpValue

  • java.lang.Object
    • hec.rss.model.OpValue
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AsciiSerializable, FieldAccessor, java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable

    public class OpValue
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.lang.Comparable, AsciiSerializable
    A simple class that holds a rule type (max, min, spec), rule value, and rule priority. The OpValue objects are stored in the OpValueSet vector.
    Version:
    1.0
    Author:
    John F. DeGeorge
    See Also:
